_comment: A ONE-OFF COMPARISON, NOT A LIBRARY ADDITION, NOT SHIPPED CONTENT.
Jafar asked on 2026-09-09 (item 4(a)) to see Codex's Hook concept
sheet beside what this lane draws from the same description. This file
exists so the shipped library is untouched: nothing here is generated
by a night `all` run, and the output goes to its own directory.
The authority is
game-design/decision-2026-09-09-the-hook-comparison-the-ruled-link-and-the-stale-pages.md
sections 1.2 to 1.6.
THE SOURCE IS THE CREATION PROMPT, NOT THE EDIT NOTE. Jafar first
named concept-final-prompts.json; that file holds image-EDIT
instructions for a board that already exists ('Make a single spatial
correction to the lower street panel of this Hook district concept
board'), and this lane has no image conditioning, so running it would
have answered a different question. He named the creation prompt
instead, and `source` below records exactly which bytes were read.
WHY THE PROMPT IS NOT VERBATIM, AND WHY THAT IS NOT A THUMB ON THE
SCALE. imagegen.py refuses a positive prompt that carries exclusion
phrasing, and the refusal is measured rather than cautious: at cfg 1.0
sd-cli never evaluates the unconditional branch, so a negative prompt
is inert and `no X` in the positive puts X into the only channel the
model reads. `no signage legible` is what produced a crisp sign board
reading WEORED S HONJ on wall_soot_brick. So each exclusion clause is
translated into positive phrasing exactly as the library did when `no
people, no cars` became `deserted, empty street` (prompts.json 122 to
124), every pair is listed in `translation` below, and NOTHING else in
the text changed. The report that accompanied this file pasted the
diff to prove it.
WHAT IS STILL NOT LIKE FOR LIKE, SAID HERE SO NOBODY HAS TO FIND IT.
Their board is three generations deep: the creation prompt below, then
concept-edit-prompts.json key `hook` (1780 characters, which pulled a
'nostalgic 1930s town' back to 1990), then concept-final-prompts.json
key `hook` (715 characters, a spatial correction). CORRECTED 2026-09-09
BY JAFAR: those passes were inspected and corrected BY CODEX ITSELF, not
by a person. This file previously said 'with a human eye between each
pass', which their PROVENANCE.md does not say: it says the concepts were
'selectively edited after visual inspection' and names no inspector. We
read 'visual inspection' and wrote 'a human eye', which is an inference
presented as a reading. SO THE COMPARISON IS MODEL AGAINST MODEL, three
passes on their side against ours, and it is fairer than this file
claimed.
OUR SIDE IS TWO PASSES AS OF 2026-09-09, AND THIS FILE IS PASS 1.
Jafar ruled the same evening that this lane draws the Hook from the
creation prompt, inspects its own draw BY VISION, and corrects once. So
the method on our side is: everything below at a fixed seed, then a model
opens the PNG it produced and writes one correction from what it can
actually see, then one further draw. THE CORRECTION PROMPT IS NOT IN
THIS FILE AND MUST NOT BE INVENTED HERE: it is written after pass 1
exists and somebody has looked at it, and a correction written before the
picture would be a prediction wearing an inspection's clothes. Nothing
below changes for pass 2; a second spec carries the correction when there
is something to correct.
THE CAPTION SAYS THREE PASSES AGAINST TWO, in those words, beside the
two boards. And it is sent whatever the result looks like: Jafar,
2026-09-09, nothing this lane produces is withheld from him for quality
or for fairness, it goes with an honest caption and he judges. Pass 1 is
still one draw per seed with no selection among draws, the seeds chosen
before anything was generated. Ours is also smaller
(see the item note) and is drawn by an eight-step distilled model
built and measured for flat plates, never for a multi-panel board.
THE SEEDS ARE THE DATE, one per item, written in this file before
anything was generated, so no agent can be accused of having chosen
the lucky draw. hook_compare is the one that goes into the correction
pass and then into the message;
s2 to s4 are banked and cost PC minutes and nothing else.
content_rules, forbidden_tokens and style.framing_required are copied
VERBATIM from tools/imagegen/prompts.json, so this file runs through
the same brand, real-person and framing guards as every shipped item.
The `concept` kind exists because the library's default prefix asks
for a 'flat orthographic texture sheet' and its default suffix ends
'one single flat surface': composed round a concept board, that is a
request for a texture sample of a picture. The prefix here is the
shortest phrase that carries style.framing_required and describes
nothing the original does not, and the suffix is PRESENT AND EMPTY
because resolve_style falls back to the default suffix when a kind
omits the key.
THERE IS NO `negatives` BLOCK ON PURPOSE. The library's
negatives.default pushes away people, crowds, faces, cars and traffic,
which is right for a deserted plate and wrong for a board the original
asks to be 'inhabited with 3 nonidentifiable people'. Each item
carries its own `negative`, which is the mirror of the translated
clauses and nothing else. At cfg 1.0 it is RECORDED AND INERT: the
manifest's negatives.inert_at_cfg1 count is what says so.
THESE RIDE IN EVERY PROMPT. They are data, not documentation, so an
editor adding a thirteenth item cannot forget them: the renderer appends
`rules_clause` to every positive prompt and refuses to build a prompt
that does not carry it (imagegen.py: build_prompt / _selftest_rules).
WHY: every 1980s British advert, poster and packet is still in copyright
for decades yet, and trade mark was the ONLY claim Getty actually won in
[2025] EWHC 2863 (Ch). A model asked for `a British high street in 1989`
will happily paint a real brewery's livery on a pub. So we never ask for
one. In-world brands only, which is better content anyway - MICKEY'S is
a place in this game and a real brewery is not.
AND THIS IS THE ONE CLAUSE THAT STAYS IN THE POSITIVE PROMPT, 25 Aug.
Every other exclusion moved to `negatives` below. This one did not, and
the reason is measured rather than cautious: sd-cli only evaluates the
unconditional branch when cfg != 1.0 (see `negatives._comment`), and this
batch runs at cfg 1.0 because Z-Image-Turbo is distilled for it. A
negative prompt is therefore INERT here - so moving the anti-brand,
anti-real-person clause into it would have deleted the only instruction
the model actually receives on the subject. It is mirrored into the
negative as well, where it will start acting the day an item raises cfg.
The exclusion scan in imagegen.py exempts this clause BY NAME and prints
that it did, so the hole is a line of output rather than a silence.
D18, 2026-09-10. THE SECOND HALF OF THIS CLAUSE IS THE CONTENT RULE,
recorded at ledger-v2/respec/decision-register/D18-content-rule.md and in
canon.md. Alcohol and gambling out entirely; nobody under eighteen and no
school in use; nothing sexual. Tobacco, violence and period swearing STAY
and are deliberately absent from the token list below.
THE CLAUSE IS BYTE-IDENTICAL ACROSS EVERY PROMPT-BEARING SPEC and that is
now CHECKED rather than hoped for: tools/content-gate.py compares all of
them against each other and against the token list, and refuses the run if
one drifts. Before that check existed, three of these files carried a
comment saying the block had been hand-copied, and one of those comments
recorded a hand copy that dropped the block entirely.
WHY THE ABSTRACT WORDS INSTRUCT AND THE CONCRETE WORDS REFUSE. This clause
rides in the POSITIVE prompt and validate_spec scans that composed prompt
against forbidden_tokens. So the clause says `no alcohol` and the tokens
say `beer`: a token list containing its own clause's words would refuse
every item in the library. Measured, not assumed. The first wording said
`nothing served or drunk` and the token `drunk` inside it would have done
exactly that; the gate's selftest caught it before it shipped.
content_rules.rules_clause: invented fictional shop name only, no real company names, no real brand logos, no trade marks, no real person, no recognisable faces, no celebrity likeness, no alcohol and no gambling anywhere in frame, nothing poured or consumed, no games of chance, nobody under eighteen and no school in use, nothing sexual

_comment: framing_required, and only framing_required, is copied verbatim
from tools/imagegen/prompts.json line 172. The default prefix and
suffix are deliberately NOT copied: see the file comment above.
by_kind.concept.prefix is the shortest phrase that satisfies
build_prompt's framing check (it contains `filling the frame edge
to edge`) while describing nothing the original does not: the
original already asks for two panels with cream margins, and a
board filling the frame is what it is.
by_kind.concept.suffix is PRESENT AND EMPTY. Omitting the key
would inherit the default suffix, which ends `one single flat
surface`.
style.framing_required: filling the frame edge to edge

concept.prefix: the whole board filling the frame edge to edge,

defaults.sampler: unset - sd-cli picks its model-specific default
_comment: steps and cfg are the library's measured settings, unchanged. cfg
1.0 is where this distilled model is measured and where the
negative channel is inert; raising it is the named next rung and
not this run. seed_base is never reached because every item
carries its own seed.

source.what: the bytes this file's prompt was translated from, so the diff can be re-derived by anyone
source.original_prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create one polished portrait environment concept sheet for LEDGER, fictional British port Meridian in 1990. Two clearly separated wide cinematic photoreal panels, top establishing view, bottom pedestrian eye-height view, with restrained cream margins. Title THE HOOK. Small subtitle AI CONCEPT / PROPOSAL. TOP: view from low dock office across an enclosed working stone basin, two-storey red brick warehouses and shop terraces, inland town gently rising behind, quay straight and narrow foot passage off it, working ropes, no pleasure marina. BOTTOM: camera at 1.6m standing at south end looking north along Quay Street, 6m wet asphalt carriageway plus 2m pavement each side, continuous brick terraces. On RIGHT/east first bay is Mickey's a SMALL SINGLE 6m-wide two-storey pub under a 35-degree slate roof, party-wall chimneys, maroon fascia MICKEY'S, two doors on near/south part of facade and wide pub window north of them. Fish shop next along right. Soot brick parapet terraces left with one narrow yard slot further up. Daytime overcast soft light, subtle wetness, inhabited with 3 nonidentifiable people in ordinary 1990 clothing, no street festival. Hand worn paint, soot streaks below gutters, domestic curtains upstairs. Photographic material plausibility, no illustration stylisation. Bottom small strip four material swatches red brick, slate, oxblood painted timber, quay stone; and objects rope fender, metal dustbin, beer firkin. No real brands or logos, no modern tech, no wheeled bins, no contemporary cars. No HUD. This is proposed art, not a screenshot.

their_image.measured: PNG IHDR read from the file on the art branch; the bytes and sha256 agree with that branch's own INVENTORY.md row
their_image.not_one_draw: their PROVENANCE.md: concepts were 'generated for this commission and selectively edited after visual inspection', and data/concept-edit-prompts.json plus data/concept-final-prompts.json both carry a `hook` edit pass

translation.why: Positive form of the same intent: the water holds trade, not leisure. `commercial cargo` is the positive of `pleasure`; `basin` is the original's own noun, already in this sentence.
Positive form: the inhabitants are having an ordinary day. The sibling prompt `copper` in the same source file says `natural varied activity`, so this is the source author's own register.

Positive form, using the original's own word: the panels are already asked for as `photoreal` in its second sentence. `rendering` was deliberately NOT used, because the source author's other prompts push `render` away (`concept not game render`).

Positive form copied from the source author's own sibling prompt `copper`, which says `Fictional unbranded signage only`. The same intent also rides in the appended content_rules.rules_clause verbatim, which is the one exclusion clause imagegen.py allows in a positive prompt and exempts from the scan by name.

translation.original_clause: no modern tech, no wheeled bins, no contemporary cars
translation.why: One positive clause for three exclusions that share one intent: a wheelie bin, a modern car and modern tech are each a thing that is not period-correct for 1990. THIS IS WEAKER THAN THE ORIGINAL and the loss is recorded rather than hidden: the three nouns are named individually in the original and only the umbrella survives in ours, because a positive naming of bins or cars would PLACE a bin or a car in a street where the source author placed neither.

NO HONEST POSITIVE EQUIVALENT: the positive of `no overlay` is nothing to draw, and any phrase naming a HUD in a positive prompt asks for one. Moved to `negative` only, where the manifest's inert_at_cfg1 count records that it did nothing at cfg 1.0.

translation.original_clause: This is proposed art, not a screenshot.
translation.why: The positive half is the source author's own sentence and is kept word for word; only the `not a ...` half moves to `negative`.

items.negative: pleasure marina, yacht, leisure moorings, pontoon, street festival, bunting, fairground, crowd, illustration, stylised illustration, cartoon, painterly, real brand logo, trade mark, real company name, modern tech, computer screen, mobile phone, wheeled bin, wheelie bin, contemporary car, modern car, HUD, heads-up display, game interface overlay, screenshot, game screenshot
_note: OURS IS SMALLER THAN THEIRS, AND THE CAPTION MUST SAY SO. hook.png is
per cent of their pixel count. 1024 is the largest long edge this lane
has banked without a blank (45 PNGs on disk: long edge 1024 x6, 896 x19,
768 x18, 512 x2; blank_check 0 blank and 0 undecodable of 41 checked and
45 rechecked). Asking for 1536 would be a size no run here has measured,
on the draw a decision is being made from.
NO PORTRAIT FRAME THIS LARGE HAS BEEN BANKED EITHER. Both numbers have
been banked separately (1024 as a long edge, 688 under the 1024 that
wall_soot_brick used) and the area is 67 per cent of the largest banked
area, but 688x1024 as a pair is new, so a blank is a live possibility and
the run prints the blank verdict per image.
